<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most distinctive pattern is the pair of peaks at m/z ≈199 (base) and m/z ≈201 (≈M+2) with nearly equal intensities (~100 and ~98). This is the characteristic isotopic signature of bromine (⁷⁹Br/⁸¹Br, ~1:1 natural abundance). No other element shows such a definitive, high‑intensity M/M+2 pattern in the data, so the only element that can be definitively identified is bromine.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
